name: selection-bar-clears-fleet-panel
description: #1423: at 1280x720 with the Fleet and Crew panels open in the left column, selecting an employee shows the selection bar. Reaches the state only: no step goal compares two element rects (expect has no rect-disjoint form), so the geometric proof lives in tests/unit/ui/shell/layoutRegions.test.ts. A vehicle cannot be selected by a player click without scene picking; the Fleet panel's locate button only moves the camera.

steps.description: Setup: staffed site so Fleet and Crew have cards
Shrink to 1280x720 and open the Fleet panel via the rail

expect.note: Fleet panel must be open in the left column

steps.description: Open Crew and locate an employee so the selection bar appears beside the open left-column panels

expect.note: selection bar visible while a left-column panel is open
